name: TetherMine - Vein Miner
statusMeaning: In the catalogue, not checked yet.
author: santrollan
description: Sneak while mining ores or logs, and TetherMine breaks the farthest connected matching block first. The starting block breaks last, drops are delivered to your feet, and modded ores and logs are supported.
evidence: Server-side mod: Kiln runs mods' code on Horizon's single-player server, not on dedicated servers. Everything its code calls is covered by Kiln development build 2026-11-24 (73dc2fb1) (55 classes, 106 members). Not run yet.

softOff.why: only events, HUD, keys, commands and guarded mixin handlers
